model.maintenance: per-algorithm non-negative affine map of execution-driven maintenance component cycles
model.reader: per-algorithm non-negative map of completed reader AXI parent requests plus execution-driven reader component cycles
model.compute: per-algorithm non-negative map of rounds, completed compute AXI parent requests, and execution-driven compute component cycles
model.iterative_span: max(predicted reader, predicted compute) plus a non-negative per-round routed overlap residual
model.total: predicted maintenance plus predicted iterative span; a zero-round residual-PageRank run is maintenance-only

mechanism_mapping.component_cycles: evaluate-commit component state, finite FIFO and AXIS backpressure, and backend response timing generated by execution
mechanism_mapping.memory_requests: issued and completed AXI parent requests from the corresponding reader or compute component
mechanism_mapping.rounds: routed reader/compute launch, control, and drain work
mechanism_mapping.span: reader and compute event intervals overlap and must never be added

supersedes.reason: The immutable v13 model failed on all three PK timing rows despite exact correctness, structural-work, and memory-ledger checks. V14 promotes PK to development data and adds the simulator's execution-driven component spans and AXI request service before freezing against SO, LJ, and LJ08.
